summary: Caller authenticated via ANI and 4-digit PIN on first attempt, requested current account balance and paid 124.50 dollars using stored Visa ending in 4412. Confirmation number read back and caller hung up satisfied.

Caller traversed 5 nested sub-menus (Main -> Internet -> Wi-Fi -> Equipment -> Advanced Settings) and was looped back to the main menu twice after selecting option 4. Caller pressed 0 repeatedly and shouted 'representative' before abandoning.

Prompt asked 'Are you calling about a new order, an existing delivery, or a trade-in Modification?' Caller said 'I need to swap the phone color on the order I placed this morning,' and ASR misclassified three times between 'new order' and 'trade-in' with low NLU confidence before caller demanded an agent.

Caller entered valid billing ZIP code and last 4 of SSN twice, but IVR CRM lookup failed to match because the account is under a corporate FEIN rather than a personal SSN. Flow locked self-service authentication and forced a security queue transfer while caller expressed frustration.

IVR announcement recited a promotional rebate deadline from November 2024 and listed store pickup hours for a retail branch that permanently closed six months ago. Caller asked 'Wait, isn't that location closed?' and pressed 0 to reach a human agent.

Caller completed full device serial number capture, issue categorization, and troubleshooting acknowledgment in the IVR, then was cold-transferred to the tier-1 queue with zero CTI screen-pop attributes attached; live agent opened with 'Can I get your name, serial number, and what you're calling about today?'
